legend: The Winchester Mystery House (San Jose, California, USA, 1884-1922)
lines: San Jose, California. A mansion that was never allowed to be finished.
Sarah Winchester inherited a rifle fortune after her husband died in 1881.
Legend says a medium warned her that restless spirits were following her.
His advice: move west, and never stop building.
So from 1884, hammers rang for decades. Some say day and night.
Stairs climb straight into the ceiling. A door opens onto a blank wall.
Legend says a bell rang every midnight, and she met her ghostly guests alone.
She died in 1922, and the building finally stopped.
Historians doubt the ghost story, but visitors still hear footsteps in empty halls.
Would you spend a night there?
title: The Mansion Built For 38 Years To Fool Ghosts... 🏚️👻 #shorts
description:
Sarah Winchester kept building her California mansion for decades. Legend says she did it to confuse restless spirits. Stairs to nowhere, doors on walls: this is the Winchester Mystery House.
